description: This Rust source file implements a web server routing module that maps incoming HTTP requests to SQL files, static assets, or error pages based on a set of routing rules and precedence. It includes logic for handling site prefixes, path resolution, file existence checks, and custom 404 error handling, along with comprehensive unit tests.

classes.name: RoutingAction
classes.description: Enum representing possible routing actions such as executing SQL files, serving static assets, redirecting, or handling not found errors.

classes.name: AppFileStore
classes.description: Struct implementing FileStore trait, encapsulating cache, filesystem, and app state for file existence checks.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Struct implementing RoutingConfig trait, holding routing configuration such as URL prefix.

methods.name: calculate_route
methods.description: Main function that determines routing action based on request path and routing rules.

methods.name: check_path
methods.description: Checks and decodes the request path, applying prefix handling and returning a PathBuf.

methods.name: calculate_route_without_extension
methods.description: Handles routing logic for paths without extensions, including directory index and redirection.

methods.name: find_file_or_not_found
methods.description: Attempts to find a file with a given extension or returns a custom 404 action.

methods.name: find_file
methods.description: Checks if a specific file exists and returns an appropriate RoutingAction.

methods.name: find_not_found
methods.description: Walks up directory tree to find a custom 404 file, or defaults to NotFound.

methods.name: append_to_path
methods.description: Appends a string (e.g., slash) to the request path for redirection.
